candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to return false for IERC165 interface id and only true for IAccessControl, flipping behavior when queried for IERC165.
Change supportsInterface to additionally claim support for an unrelated interface id (0xffffffff) by returning true when queried for it.
Change supportsInterface to always return false, making it report no supported interfaces.
Change supportsInterface to always return true, making it report support for any interface id.
Return the inverse of the stored membership flag (negate the boolean) so hasRole returns true when the account is not a member and false when it is.
Change getRoleAdmin to return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead of reading stored admin role, causing all roles to report DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as admin.
Change getRoleAdmin to return the role argument itself, making every role report itself as its admin.
Change getRoleAdmin to return the zero bytes32 constant (0x0) unconditionally, so all roles have admin role 0x0 (equivalent to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE but done by literal).
Change getRoleAdmin to return the stored adminRole XORed with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, altering reported admin to a different bytes32 value derived from storage.
Change getRoleAdmin to return the complement (~) of the stored adminRole, flipping bits of the stored admin role.
